programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T3 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: John viaja até Montreal, Quebeque, para devorar um esparguete espetacular repleto de molho de trufas e uma perfeita gema de ovo a 64 graus. Em Milwaukee, no Wisconsin, John atira-se a uma fritada de peixe tradicional do Wisconsin e prova um lúcio-perca fresquinho do lago. De seguida, em Wellington, Ontário, John risca da sua lista de desejos os tacos caseiros Al Pastor que são um autêntico sonho.

programme.title: Renovation Resort T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Scott e Bryan trabalham em conjunto na margem, enquanto as equipas se dirigem para o salão, no terceiro desafio. Vão precisar de criatividade e mestria para conquistar a Construção Extra surpresa.

programme.title: Renovation Resort T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Scott e Bryan vão à pesca, enquanto as equipas trabalham no espaço discutivelmente mais importante numa casa de férias, a cozinha. Para aumentar a pressão, uma grande Construção Extra deixa as equipas em apuros.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T2 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: A família Van Beek está à procura de um cão resgatado especial para adotar e acolher no seu lar ativo. Recebem a visita de três cães resgatados. A Juliet, um cruzamento de shi tzu, o Jett, um cruzamento de pug e jack russell e a Emily, um cruzamento de terrier australiano. Como será que vão decidir?.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T2 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: A família Ludlow visita o Boston terrier, o corgi e o welsh terrier, na esperança de encontrar um novo cachorrinho para crescer com as duas filhas pequenas.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T6 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Scott ajuda Jennifer e Mike, que querem desesperadamente tornar sua casa de férias mais acessível e atrativa para os hóspedes.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Em várias regiões de França, novos proprietários de elegantes, mas muitas vezes degradados, castelos e palácios, lançam-se na aventura de os restaurar e transformar em lares de sonho e negócios sustentáveis.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Em várias regiões de França, novos proprietários de elegantes, mas muitas vezes degradados, castelos e palácios, lançam-se na aventura de os restaurar e transformar em lares de sonho e negócios sustentáveis.

programme.title: Eco Reset - Ep. 5
programme.desc: No Gavião Nature Village, Vera Kolodzig e Áurea viajam ao encontro de tradições que resistem ao tempo. Uma experiência que celebra a simplicidade, o conforto e a beleza do território.

programme.title: Mudanças Na Casa De Família - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Kortney e Dave Wilson trabalham com Cheryl Hickey para transformar uma casa cheia de problemas numa casa de luxo para Sarah e Kevin; Landon, de 12 anos, precisou de cuidados permanentes durante toda a sua vida devido a uma perturbação rara do desenvolvimento.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T3 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Nadia e Anwar compraram a casa de fazenda numa quinta como uma propriedade geracional para desfrutar com suas filhas, mas também com a intenção de gerar alguma renda de aluguer a curto prazo.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T3 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: A decisão de Caroline e Gihad, profissionais de saúde da linha da frente, de comprar uma casa de campo foi influenciada pelos seus empregos. Elas queriam um lugar para relaxar e descomprimir.

programme.title: Kitchen Nightmares (USA) T8 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Ramsay intervém para reavaliar as prioridades do South Brooklyn Foundry e orientar as finanças.

programme.title: Kitchen Nightmares (USA) T8 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: O chef Ramsay tenta transformar o Max´s Bar And Grill antes que o negócio dos proprietários divorciados se desmorone.

programme.title: Ó Da Casa T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Se gostas de personalizar a decoração da tua casa, neste episódio, a Joana vai dar-te ideias incríveis. Primeiro, descobre como podes criar um candeeiro original, aproveitando um abajur básico, e depois, segue os passos da construção de um porta lenha.

programme.title: Comer Pelo Mundo T2 - Ep. 30
programme.desc: A nossa viajante incansável Verónica Zumalacárregui volta ao Canal com novos episódios de “Comer Pelo Mundo”. Mais uma vez, pela sua mão, iremos conhecer a gastronomia autêntica de cada uma das cidades que visita. Neste episódio Verónica viaja até Macau.

programme.title: Aqui Há Mão T2 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: As bonecas de pano fazem parte de uma tradição recuperada, em Lisboa, por Benedetta Maxia. Com Fátima Lopes, vamos conhecer as criações de Benedetta e viajamos ainda até Penha Garcia, para conhecer as tradicionais “Maias” de Adelaide Marques.

programme.title: Lista De Desejos Gastronómicos T3 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: John viaja até St. John’s, na Nova Terra, para aprender a arte de cozinhar sobre fogo e provar uns pastéis de peixe autênticos da Terra Nova. De seguida, John dirige-se a Chicago, no Illinois, para explorar o mundo da cozinha peruana e comer uma dose generosa do prato típico de Lima, arroz frito com marisco e uma omelete em cima.

programme.title: Repo Men: Os Cobradores
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo, é possível comprar órgãos artificiais a crédito, mas quem não os paga recebe a visita de uma equipa de cobradores que não tem pruridos em arrancá-los dos novos corpos. Só que um deles vê-se com um coração artificial e vai ter de lutar para se manter vivo.

programme.title: Há Dias De Azar…
programme.desc: Um erro de identificação coloca Slevin no meio de uma guerra travada pelos dois líderes da máfia nova-iorquina. Perseguido por um assassino profissional e sob intensa vigilância do detetive Brikowski, ele terá que encontrar uma forma de escapar com vida da confusão em que entrou...

programme.title: Arsenal
programme.desc: Os irmãos JP e Mikey tiveram uma infância complicada. Atualmente, o primeiro é dono de uma empresa de construção mas o segundo é um pequeno mafioso, que é raptado pelo criminoso Eddie King. JP vai arriscar tudo para resgatar o irmão, que sempre fez tudo por ele.

programme.title: O Uivo
programme.desc: Numa noite de tempestade, o último comboio de Londres trava de emergência numa floresta. O maquinista sai para investigar e desaparece, os passageiros ficam em pânico ao ouvirem uivos vindos da escuridão e há uma criatura à solta que obriga a que todos se juntem para sobreviver.

programme.title: A Balada De Adam Henry
programme.desc: Fiona Maye é uma juíza que tem de julgar o caso de um adolescente de 17 anos com leucemia que é Testemunha de Jeová e se recusa, por motivos religiosos, a receber uma transfusão de sangue que o poderá ajudar a salvar a vida.

programme.title: Todos Sabem
programme.desc: Laura viaja com os filhos de Buenos Aires até à sua aldeia-natal perto de Madrid para assistir ao casamento da irmã, mas uma série de acontecimentos desencadeia uma crise familiar que vai expor segredos do passado.

programme.title: Mascarade
programme.desc: Quando um jovem gigolo se apaixona por uma irresistível vigarista, um esquema desonesto é concebido à luz do sol escaldante da Côte d´Azur. Na busca de uma vida de luxo, irão os dois amantes tão longe a ponto de sacrificar o sustento de um agente imobiliário e de uma estrela de cinema reformada?

programme.title: Mulher De Ouro
programme.desc: Maria Altmann, uma octogenária judia austríaca refugiada nos EUA, não se vai deter perante nada para recuperar os bens da sua família apreendidos pelos nazis, entre eles um famoso quadro de Gustav Klimt, missão em que será ajudada por um corajoso mas inexperiente advogado.

programme.title: Invisível Nas Cores
programme.desc: Quando os poderes de Ruth são descobertos, ela é forçada a abandonar a sua família. Anos depois, a sua missão de permanecer invisível leva-a de volta a casa, o único sítio onde estará segura, junto da sua mãe e da sua filha, também elas com super-poderes.

programme.title: Sempre A Abrir
programme.desc: Para ajudar a namorada a ir a uma entrevista de emprego em Los Angeles, o ex-motorista de fugas Charlie Bronson quebra a regra de isolamento a que está imposto pelo Plano de Proteção de Testemunhas mas é implacavelmente perseguido estrada fora pelo FBI e pelo seu ex-gangue.

programme.title: Impacto Mortífero
programme.desc: Steve Wakes é um detetive da polícia determinado a encontrar o assassino que lhe matou o parceiro, num tiroteio que atingiu Madison, uma testemunha essencial no processo. Só que o seu grande receio confirma-se: os assassinos são dois polícias corruptos dispostos a tudo para encobrir o crime…

programme.title: Dog: A Aventura De Uma Vida
programme.desc: Briggs, um ex-ranger do exército, é encarregue de conduzir Lulu, um pastor belga militar de comportamento agressivo, pela costa do Pacífico até ao funeral do seu dono, numa jornada em que ambos terão de lidar com os traumas do seu passado e encontrar um ponto de equilíbrio.

programme.title: A Modista
programme.desc: Quando Tilly regressa a casa, numa pequena cidade rural australiana, vai reconciliar-se com a mãe doente e vai recorrer à sua experiência na alta costura para transformar as mulheres locais e vingar-se de quem antes lhe tinha feito mal.

programme.title: Sou O Teu Homem
programme.desc: Para obter fundos de pesquisa para os seus estudos, uma cientista aceita uma oferta para participar numa experiência extraordinária: durante três semanas, ela deve viver com um robô humanoide, criado para fazê-la feliz.

programme.title: Safe - O Intocável
programme.desc: Mei é uma jovem de memória prodigiosa que tem na cabeça um código numérico que a leva a ser perseguia pelas tríades chinesas, a máfia russa e polícias corruptos de Nova Iorque. Em seu auxílio surge um ex-polícia caído em desgraça que não se vai deter perante nada para a proteger..

programme.title: Joe
programme.desc: O atormentado Joe Ransom tenta esquecer o seu passado turbulento levando uma vida tranquila numa pequena cidade do Texas, onde conhece Gary, um rapaz de 15 anos, de quem acaba por tornar-se mentor e que acaba por defender de um pai violento e abusivo.

programme.title: Vem Ao Papá
programme.desc: Após receber uma carta enigmática do seu pai, que não vê desde os cinco anos, Norval viaja para ir ter com ele, na esperança de que esta seja uma oportunidade para se reaproximarem. Mas será que se ele soubesse a verdade sombria sobre o seu progenitor, ele o teria reencontrado?

programme.title: Um Lugar Especial
programme.desc: Monty Wildhorn, um escritor de westerns alcoólico, perdeu a força criativa. Quando o sobrinho o convence a passar o verão em Belle Isle, ele começa a tornar-se amigo de uma mãe solteira e das suas três filhas, que lhe vão dar inspiração para começar a escrever outra vez.

programme.title: Diabolik
programme.desc: A história sombria e romântica do primeiro encontro entre o mestre ladrão Diabolik e a sedutora Eva Kant, no final da década de 1960, com o inspetor Ginko determinado a acabar com os planos do larápio, que desta feita tenta roubar um valioso diamante.

programme.title: O Quadrado
programme.desc: Christian é o respeitado curador de um museu de arte contemporânea de Estocolmo, que tenta montar uma polémica instalação enquanto se encontra numa crise pessoal e profissional.

programme.title: Traidora Americana: O Julgamento De Axis Sally
programme.desc: Mildred Gillars é uma cantora a atriz americana que transmitiu propaganda nazi aos seus compatriotas durante a Segunda Guerra Mundial. Apelidada de Axis Sally pelos soldados americanos, esta história verídica estende-se à sua captura e ao seu julgamento por traição no pós-guerra.

programme.title: Guardiãs Do Túmulo
programme.desc: Numa missão de salvamento do irmão, Jia descobre o túmulo subterrâneo de um antigo imperador chinês, que viveu uma vida estranhamente longa 200 anos antes de Cristo, só que rapidamente percebe que desenterrou também um segredo que devia ter ficado para sempre soterrado.

programme.title: Kursk
programme.desc: A 12 de agosto do ano 2000, o submarino russo Kursk afundou-se no Mar de Barents, num desastre foi muito agravado por negligência governamental. Enquanto os marinheiros lutam pela sobrevivência debaixo de água, as suas famílias esbarram em obstáculos políticos e na impossibilidade de salvá-los.

programme.title: Dia da Redenção
programme.desc: Kate Paxton é raptada em Marrocos pelo líder de um grupo terrorista. Acabado de regressar a casa, Brad Paxton, capitão do exército americano, vê-se forçado a embarcar numa nova missão de resgate, desta vez para salvar a mulher que ama.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: Mais de 300 mil soldados aliados da Bélgica, do Império Britânico e da França são cercados pelo exército alemão e evacuados da zona costeira de Dunquerque durante a Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Os Vizinhos Lá De Cima
programme.desc: Xavier e Sophie são casados há 25 anos mas a sua relação sofre um forte abalo quando convidam para jantar o jovem casal que mora no andar de cima, que fará com que eles se apercebam da monotonia da sua vida diária e se vejam desafiados por uma proposta ligeiramente… indecente!

programme.title: Toro
programme.desc: Dois irmãos reencontram-se ao fim de dois anos: um deles tem estado preso, o outro roubou um perigoso recetador e agora estão ambos em fuga, juntamente com Diana, a filha menor do último, numa viagem pela Andaluzia violenta, mítica, agreste e selvagem.

programme.title: Contrato Para Matar
programme.desc: John Harmon, um agente da CIA, investiga um plano para usar as redes de tráfico de droga do México para fazer entrar armas e líderes extremistas nos EUA.

programme.title: O Segredo Do Refúgio
programme.desc: Dois casais alugam um refúgio perfeito à beira-mar, mas em pouco tempo o que deveria ser um fim de semana de descanso assume contornos sinistros…

programme.title: Von Weber - Der Freischütz
programme.desc: This unique production of Carl Maria von Weber’s ‘Der Freischütz’ was created to celebrate both the piece’s 200th premiere anniversary at Konzerthaus Berlin and the 200th anniversary of the famed concert hall itself.

programme.title: Bach - St. John Passion
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the marvelous Berliner Philharmoniker and performs Johann Sebastian Bach's splendid St. John Passion. The solo voice parts are sung by the renowned soloists Juliane Banse, Michael Chance, Ian Bostridge, Rainer Trost and Thomas Quasthoff. Also joining is the famous RIAS Kammerchor. Bach composed his passion, based on the Gospel of John, during his first year as director of church music in Leipzig.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces – Dvorák – Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In this documentary, Antonín Dvorák’s popular ‘Symphony No.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: American conductor Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in an energetic performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17. Written in 1872, the work is nicknamed 'Little Russian' as the composer used several folk tunes from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia’. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's, London, on May 31, 2021.

programme.title: Berg - Piano Sonata, Op. 1
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Alban Berg’s Piano Sonata in B minor, Op. 1. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Hunting Brass
programme.desc: The German Brass is one of the most original and distinctive brass ensembles in the world. This group of talented musicians performs classical arrangements, dance versions of standards, and popular tunes that reflect an exceptional musical spirit.

programme.title: De Falla - El sombrero de tres picos - Suite No. 2
programme.desc: During the New Year’s Gala 2010, the Berlin Philharmonic perform under the baton of Gustavo Dudamel, whose infectious energy and exceptional artistry have made him one of the most sought-after conductors by orchestras and opera companies around the world. They welcome mezzo-soprano Elina Garanca, who has become one of the world’s most famous singers within just a few years.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets Nos. 1, 9 And 10
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Solos for Clarinet, Part I
programme.desc: The great clarinettist Paolo Beltramini plays a program of solo pieces for clarinet on Stingray Brava. In this broadcast, Beltramini performs C.P.E. Bach’s Solfeggietto, Béla Kovàc’s Hommage à Paganini, and Igor Stravinsky’s Three Pieces for Clarinet Solo. Paolo Beltramini is the only Italian clarinettist to have won first prize at the prestigious Prague Spring International Clarinet Competition (1996).

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret?

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Francesco Durante Missa per I Morti
programme.desc: In the impressive Jacobikerk, artist in residence Marco Mencoboni will make Francesco Durante’s magnificent Requiem shimmer, with orchestra, soloists, two choirs, and a pair of French horns in the main role. With the breathtaking vocal control of soprano Valentina Mastrangelo – rising star of bel canto – this concert will be a highlight of the Festival.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career.

programme.title: Rachmaninov And Gershwin: Rhapsodies
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia is joined by acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin. Conductor Konstantin Khvatynets directs this concert, filmed at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 1, Op. 11
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 1 in F-sharp minor, Op. 11. Schumann completed the work in 1835 and dedicated it to his beloved, Clara Wieck.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - The Carnival of the Animals
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’s musical suite The Carnival of the Animals (Le carnaval des animaux, 1886). This suite consists of 14 movements, each depicting a different animal.

programme.title: Gara Garayev : Autumn Sonatas
programme.desc: Pianist Vadim Repin and Violist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano. Recorded at La Grange au Lac. Written and directed by Juliette Swierczewski and recorded at La Grange au Lac. Although Garayev is a 20th century composer, his music nonetheless carries allusions to romantic music.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Mahler's 'Resurrection' Symphony, written between 1888 and 1894, is a colossal five-movement work exploring themes of death and resurrection. It was one of Mahler's most popular and acclaimed works during his lifetime, famously culminating in a powerful choral finale.

programme.title: The Four Seasons
programme.desc: We all know 'The Four Seasons of Vivaldi', it is one of the 'hits' of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi’s famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV?

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Johan de Meij - Echoes of San Marco And Fellini
programme.desc: This concert is the result of the collaboration between the Giuseppe Nicolini Conservatory of Piacenza and the Giuseppe Verdi of Milan as part of the project 'MIlanoPIACEnza ... suonare insieme.” On the program are works by the Dutch conductor and composer Johan de Meij. “Echoes of San Marco” is a tribute to the Venetian Renaissance composer Giovanni Gabrieli (1555-1612).

programme.title: Waldbühne 2004 - Tchaikovsky night
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker and Lang Lang under the baton of Sir Simon Rattle.

programme.title: Rota - The Godfather Suite
programme.desc: This exclusive live concert production presents a unique selection of movie classics - from Sergio Leone’s iconic Spaghetti Westerns to modern mafia masterpieces by Francis Ford Coppola and the cult movies of Tarantino. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra and Concert Choir are conducted by Sarah Hicks in this premiere performance of authentic soundtracks by composer legends Ennio Morricone, Nino Rota, Sonny Bono and Bernard Herrmann.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Symphony No. 2 in E minor, Op. 27
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Symphony No. 2 in E minor, Op. 27. After the disastrous premiere of the composer’s Symphony No. 1 in 1897, Rachmaninoff seriously doubted his ability as a symphonist. Almost a decade later, in October 1906, he started composing his Symphony No. 2. Months of revisions followed.

programme.title: Pedal Piano Concert - Schumann, Liszt a. o.
programme.desc: The pedal piano was a very popular instrument in the nineteenth century. Several composers, including Franz Liszt, Charles Gounod, and Camille Saint-Saëns, adapted old pieces or wrote new ones for this piano. Roberto Prosseda is one of the rare pianists performing on this instrument today.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 31, Op. 110
programme.desc: Can we get into Beethoven’s creative mind, especially in the last phase of his life, when he was coping with severe hearing loss? Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Iolanta
programme.desc: ‘Iolanta’ and ‘Perséphone’ – A double bill consisting of two stage works that “represent an ideal of beauty, poetry and hope” forms this new production by Peter Sellars in Madrid from the Teatro Real from 2012. In both works, the progression from darkness to light acts as an initiation rite that completely transforms the existential attitude of the leading characters.

programme.title: The spirits of Mozart
programme.desc: A crossover experience inspired by the music of Mozart: the surprising and original Spirits of Mozart. In this crossover concert, outstanding personalities from the fields of pop, jazz and classical music interpret Mozart`s compositions in their personal musical languages for a broad public of the 21st century. These performances show that the impact of Mozart`s music reaches far beyond the boundaries of classical music.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff: Piano Concerto No. 3,Op 30
programme.desc: The legendary pianist Vladimir Horowitz (1903-1989) won his first praise on his interpretation of Rachmaninoff's Third Piano Concerto from the composer himself. When Rachmaninoff heard the young Kiev-born pianist play his work shortly after Horowitz's arrival in New York in 1928, he exclaimed: 'He swallowed it whole.' Fifty years later, on September 24, 1978, Horowitz electrified his audience once again with this monumental work.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 8, K 246
programme.desc: Not only was Mozart unlucky in love in Mannheim, but he also failed to achieve his ambition of becoming a court composer. The young lady Antonia Lützow, for whom he wrote his Piano Concerto No. 8, was not a very accomplished performer, but in all its simplicity, this concerto is seldom short of sublime. In this episode, soloist Christian Zacharias performs Mozart’s Piano Concerto No.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 3
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek’s only symphony – was never performed during the composer’s lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today.

programme.title: Playing Portraits
programme.desc: The trio composed of Alessandro Carbonare (clarinet), Elisa Eleonora Papandrea (violin) and Monaldo Braconi (piano) performs regularly in Italy’s concert halls and abroad. Playing Portraits showcases the trio’s appearances in various places, including USA, Russia and Europe, as they perform works by composers such as George Gershwin, Igor Stravinsky, Francis Poulenc, Anton Guilio Priolo, and Reiner Kuttenberger.

programme.title: The Boy with the Wig: Kids on Mozart
programme.desc: The Boy with the Wig - Kids on Mozart explores children’s fascination with the composer. The 30-minute film by Claus Wischmann features boys and girls aged between eight and eleven recounting his life through humour and serious interpretations of Mozart’s biography. Discover Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart through the eyes of children.

programme.title: Liszt - Piano Concerto No. 2, S.125
programme.desc: Alexander Ullman (1991, United Kingdom) performs Franz Liszt's Piano Concerto No. 2 (S125) during the final of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht 2017. The competition actively presents, develops and promotes piano talents from around the world. In doing so, it has become one of the prominent gateways to the international professional classical music scene for young musicians.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Baroque works by Bach, Muffat and Rameau
programme.desc: Paul Goodwin conducts the Conjunto Barroco of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid in a Baroque music program featuring works by Georg Muffat, J. S. Bach, and Jean-Philippe Rameau. On the program are Muffat’s Sonata No. 5 in G major, 'Armonico tributo'; Bach’s Orchestral Suite No. 4 in D major, BWV 1069; and Rameau’s Suite from the opera ‘Les Boréades’.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Chamber Symphony Op. 110a
programme.desc: The Casco Phil, The Chamber Music Orchestra of Belgium, conducted by Benjamin Haemhouts, performs Shostakovich’s Chamber Symphony, Op. 110a. The work is a transcription by Rudolf Barshai of Shostakovich’s String Quartet No. 8, which was composed in only three days (July 12 to 14 1960). The work draws from Shostakovich’s pieces, like the Symphonies No. 1 and 5, and a Jewish theme from Piano Trio No. 2.

programme.title: Yutaka Sado And Berliner Philharmoniker
programme.desc: With this concert, Yutaka Sado makes his Philharmonic debut and will be the first Japanese to conduct the renowned orchestra since Seiji Ozawa several years ago. Critics have unanimously hailed Yutaka Sado as one of the most enthralling and charismatic conductors of the new generation. The long-time assistant of Leonard Bernstein and Seiji Ozawa was awarded the most important conductor’s prizes.

programme.title: Martinu° - Concertino for Piano Trio and Strings
programme.desc: The Italian-Swiss ensemble Trio des Alpes, consisting of Hana Kotková (violin), Claude Hauri (cello), and Corrado Greco (piano), and the Orchestra da Camera di Mantova join forces in this performance of the Concertino for Piano Trio and String Orchestra, H. 232 by Czech composer Bohuslav Martin (1890-1959). Martin was a prolific composer, creating an oeuvre of almost 400 works.

programme.title: Le Sacre: A ballet in two parts by Uwe Scholz
programme.desc: Uwe Scholz, one of the most important choreographers of the 20th century, created two interpretations of Igor Stravinsky’s Le Sacre du Printemps for the Leipzig Ballet. Sacre I, for one dancer, can be interpreted as a bleak and oppressive dance about Scholz’ own life. This unique solo is performed by Giovanni Di Palma to the four-handed piano version.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 4, 5 And 12
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Mahler – The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Mahler: Das Lied von der Erde, performed live by Carlos Miguel Prieto conducting the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, with mezzo-soprano Ruxandra Donose and tenor Ramón Vargas, presents Mahler’s song-symphony — one of the composer’s most profound masterpieces.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Glass - Double Concerto for Two Pianos
programme.desc: As part of a new collaboration with the famous composer of 'music with repetitive structures' Philip Glass, French pianists Katia and Marielle Labèque perform the European premiere of Glass's Concerto for two pianos with the Orchester de Paris conducted by Jaap van Zweden, current music director of the New York Philharmonic.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 And No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. Composed in 1803 and 1804, this symphony is regarded as a major turning point in Beethoven’s oeuvre as well as Western music history. Symphony No. 3 is longer in duration than any previous symphony.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 3
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major, K. 216. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist.

programme.title: Thomas - Hamlet
programme.desc: Hamlet is a grand opera in five acts by the French composer Ambroise Thomas (1811-1896), with a libretto by Michel Carré and Jules Barbier. It is based on a French adaptation by Alexandre Dumas and Paul Meurice of Shakespeare's Hamlet. Thomas’ operas Mignon (1866) and Hamlet (1868) were largely neglected during the 20th century but experienced somewhat of a revival over the last decades.

programme.title: Waldbühne 1999 - A Romantic Opera Night
programme.desc: This concert at the Waldbühne in Berlin celebrates the legacy of Wagner and his most famous successor, Richard Strauss. This concert features the Berliner Philharmoniker, soloist Ben Heppner, and is directed by James Levine, Metropolitan Opera's music director for nearly 40 years. Strauss's works on the evening program include Don Juan, op. 20; Cäcilie and Heimliche Aufforderung, Op. 27; Zueignung, Op.

programme.title: Summertime at the Domaine Forget
programme.desc: The documentary Summertime at the Domaine Forget introduces internationally renowned treasure: Domaine Forget festival in Saint-Irénée, Québec. Domaine Forget is one of Canada's leading music academies and hosts this annual festival to promote music and dance.

Na leitura da Palavra de Deus temos a oportunidade de sermos curados e restaurados. Na Palavra, Deus fala connosco e nos comunica Sua Sabedoria.

programme.title: Tarde Em Familia
programme.desc: Um programa realizado em direto tanto na televisão, como na rádio e este acontece no estúdio da rádio. programme.title: Minha Terra Minha Gente
programme.desc: “Minha Terra, Minha Gente” apresenta o melhor dos 308 concelhos do território, através da tradição, da inovação e da sustentabilidade. São empolgantes histórias de vida que personificam o amor à terra. Memórias das pessoas e dos locais, para as gerações futuras, com testemunhos marcantes e inspiradores de gente apaixonada: usos, costumes e tradições do rico património de Portugal. .

programme.desc: Conversas simples em que cada host convida o seu mundo de pessoas. programme.title: Juca
programme.desc: “Juca” , apresentado por Júlio Magalhães, que chega ao ecrã de segunda a quinta-feira, entre as 21h00 e as 22h30. Num ambiente de late night descontraído, o jornalista deixa de lado o fato e a gravata para receber convidados sentados no sofá, em conversas próximas sobre atualidade, cultura, entretenimento e histórias de vida que ajudam a contar o país.

programme.title: Intercidades
programme.desc: O Intercidades é a viagem regional de fim de tarde do Conta Lá, conduzida por Rita Ferro Rodrigues, em estúdio, e uma vasta equipa de repórteres sempre em movimento pelas regiões. O programa distingue-se pelo olhar atento ao país, ligando estúdio e território em tempo real. O comboio vai parar nos vários concelhos e levar-nos até quem faz cada localidade — do café à escola, do campo à praça.

programme.title: A Letra: Marco Rodrigues - 'Mãe'
programme.desc: Num formato intimista de 11 minutos, o programa acompanha Margarida Pinto Correia em conversas próximas com músicos, centradas no significado das letras e no processo criativo por trás das canções. Marco Rodrigues quase não consegue cantar 'Mãe', a canção que Marisa Liz lhe ofereceu depois da sua mãe partir. Judite era adorada pelos amigos e colegas, e todos a quiseram homenagear.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 39
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Segure Minha Mão T1 - Ep. 29
programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 35
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 73
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 37
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: Earl Hines Quartet in Spa, 1977
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can’t Believe That You’re In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.

programme.title: Chick Corea And Gary Burton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Al McKay's Earth, Wind And Fire Experience
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Bebop
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Ostrich Quartet
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Thomas Carbou: Spectacle Au Bleury
programme.desc: Thomas Carbou and Patrick Graham share an almost telepathic rapport, blending spontaneous improvisation, electronic looping, and Brazilian and Indian musical influences to create ecstatic groove pieces and dream-like soundscapes.

programme.title: The Tällberg Foundation: 'Jazz for the Planet'
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano).

programme.title: Visions of Music: Carnet des Routes
programme.desc: Visions of Music - World Jazz invites the viewer on a journey to the roots of music, introducing the enormous impact that traditional music from around the world has had on contemporary jazz. This program features legendary musicians such as BB King, Dino Saluzzi, Tito Puente, Carlos Santana, Zawinul Joe, Manu Dibango, Abdullah Ibrahim, as well as new generation representatives such as Nicholas Payton, Cyro Baptista, and Don Byron.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Liz McComb in Paris: Back to Blues
programme.desc: This film is a souvenir of an extraordinary concert. It reveals the true personality of Liz Mc Comb: more than a great gospel singer, she is a lover who dreams of sharing her generosity with us. Liz Mc Comb sings, among others, 'I'm Just a Poor Wayfaring Stranger' for all the immigrants in the world, followed by her famous 'Time Is Now'.

programme.title: Trio Chemirani: Dawâr
programme.desc: The veritable tombak virtuosos of Trio Chemirani, consisting of Chemirani Senior and Juniors, enrapture the Festival de Saintes. The tombak is a Persian percussion instrument, but its rhythms are universal. The Trio Chemirani’s music is accessible to all and will certainly resound with each listener. The members of the trio, Djamchid Chemirani (born in Teheran in 1942) and his two sons and pupils Keyvan and Bijan, are living in France.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Tokyo
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1982, legendary jazz clarinettist Benny Goodman performed at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague with his septet.

programme.title: New Cool Collective Big Band at the Oosterpoort
programme.desc: New Cool Collective have been happily grooving on 24 years of fame thanks to their unique mix of jazz, dance, latin, salsa, afrobeat and boogaloo. As pioneers in the Dutch jazz scene NCC has received many awards and the band have toured the great expanses of Europe, Asia and North America.

programme.title: Episode 6: Herbie Hancock - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American keyboard player and bandleader Herbie Hancock (1940) achieved success as an incisive, harmonically provocative jazz pianist in the 1960s, then went on to gain wide popularity as a leader of electric jazz-rock groups. One of these, Hancock’s band The Headhunters, ushered in a new era of jazz that appealed to a far wider audience, making jazz listeners out of rhythm and blues fans, and vice versa.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Swing Dealers
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music.

programme.title: James Brown - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1981, legendary American singer James Brown gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Jazzmeia Horn, Free Your Mind
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Morgenland Festival: One Way Ticket to Damascus
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: Crossroads: From Blues to Bossa
programme.desc: A two-part documentary, moderated by Dee Dee Bridgewater. Part 1: From Blues to Bossa On the search for the roots and origins of Jazz, we journey into the European and African music traditions and discover the cultural heritages of Jazz from Rio to New Orleans.

programme.title: Os Capoeira - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Os Capoeira.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Tambours de Brazzas
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: Song for my Father
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Ladama - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Wolfert Brederode
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Episode 4: Stan Getz - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American jazz tenor saxophonist Stan Getz (1927-1991) was nicknamed 'The Sound' for his warm, lyrical tone. Performing in bebop and cool jazz groups, he popularized bossa nova in America with the hit 'The Girl from Ipanema'.

programme.title: Omer Avital Qantar - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. Israeli-American double bassist Omer Avital plays radiantly energetic, resounding jazz with oriental influences. At Jazz in Duketown 2019, Avital forms a quintet with saxophonists Asaf Yuria and Alexander Levin, drummer Ofri Nehemya, and pianist Eden Ladin.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: VIVA!
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. “Viva” is a perfect mixture of various instruments and musicians from all over the world.

programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Burton And Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: George Shearing Duo feat. Neil Swainson
programme.desc: British pianist George Shearing enjoyed an international reputation as an instrumentalist, arranger, and composer. Equally at home on the classical concert stage as in jazz clubs, he was recognized for his inventive, orchestrated jazz. In this live recording from the Munich Philharmonie, Shearing played in a duo format with Canadian double bassist Neil Swainson.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: NSJ Archive: Astrud Gilberto And Stan Getz
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Sly Johnson And Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: Spyro Gyra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, the American jazz fusion band Spyro Gyra took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone.

programme.title: Bass solo
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Wynton in the South Bank Show
programme.desc: Considered one of the most technically brilliant players in the history of the trumpet, jazz musician Wynton Marsalis is also a master of classical music and a fine composer. Marsalis takes the cameras with him around New York, to his home town of New Orleans, and to his rehearsal studios where he and his assembled band of musicians are seen putting together the album Blood on the Fields.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: Lucky Peterson - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Toko Telo - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Sammy Price and the Harlem Beggars
programme.desc: Pianist, singer and civil rights activist Sammy Price is joined by the gospel singers known as the Harlem Beggars for spirited renditions of “Go Tell It on the Mountain,” “I’m a Soldier,” and “When the Saints Go Marching In,” among several others. The group is joined by Wilbert Harrison, who provides accompaniment on organ.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Ben Sluijs
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content. Saxophonist Ben Sluijs received a classical training.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jackie Davis in concert in Brussels
programme.desc: American soul jazz singer and organist Jackie Davis (1920-1999) contributed greatly to the popularity of the Hammond B3 organ in jazz, preceding even the great Jimmy Smith. Seen here during an intimate solo performance in Brussels in 1967, we get to enjoy Davis’ every musical twist and lyrical turn.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jozy
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Al di Meola - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1993, American guitarist Al Di Meola was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham And Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers’ came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career.

programme.title: Eartha Kitt: The Most Exciting Woman in the World
programme.desc: They called her “the most exciting woman in the world”, and this Afro-American voice lived up to this expectation with international flair. Eartha Kitt was one of the reigning queens of blues and jazz. She epitomized the idea of the sex-kitten chanteuse, rising to fame with a nightclub act centered on her slinky stage presence and throaty purr.

programme.title: O.P. Trio and E. Fitz. - Jazz At The Philharmonic
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented his Jazz at the Philharmonic tour at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: MEGA Fights T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features former champions Paul 'The Punisher' Williams (38-1, 27 KOs) and 'El Asesino' Kermit Cintron (32-2, 28 KOs) in a middleweight battle. The fight took place at the Home Depot Center in Carson, California, USA, on May 8, 2010.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: This episode features a bout between boxing legends Manny Pacquiao and Oscar De La Hoya, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is a light heavyweight championship contest featuring Bernard Hopkins and Jean Pascal meeting for a second time. Their original contest, just five months earlier, resulted in a controversial draw, and the WBC ordered a rematch. Also on the card, action from young heavyweight stud Deontay Wilder.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T29 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 3, from Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan, features Kotoshoho, Shodai, Takayasu and Takanosho.

programme.title: World Karate Federation T2023 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: The highest level of competition in the sport of karate anywhere in the world will take place from Budapest, Hungary, as the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS take place. The top competitors from across the globe, from six different continents, will all converge on Budapest to stake their claim as the best in the world. Don't miss the WKF SENIOR WORLD CHAMPIONSHIPS, only on FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: XMA T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: In this episode we focus on the martial art of breaking and how the techniques are fine-tuned with technology.

programme.title: FIGHT SPORTS MMA T1 - Ep. 189
programme.desc: This episode features coverage of the interim Middleweight Championship as Garreth 'SoldierBoy' McLellan and Brendan 'Descendant' Lesar meet in the hexagon. Bonus coverage includes Matunga Djikasa vs. Ivan Strydom and Devon Cronje vs. Guy Mongambi.

programme.desc: Duas amigas fazem uma viagem antes de se candidatarem à universidade. Uma delas não chega a casa e todos perguntam o que terá acontecido em Las Vegas.

programme.title: On the Case with Paula Zahn T14 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Como é que o plano de uma jovem para um jantar de S. Valentim acabou num homicídio? A polícia tem de encontrar a pista para responder a essa pergunta.

programme.title: Deadly Influence: The Social Media Murders T2 - Ep. 3

programme.title: Fatal Destination T1 - Ep. 4

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt T3 - Ep. 5

programme.title: Murder In The Heartland T6 - Ep. 10

programme.title: Still A Mystery T5 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Os sonhos de um jovem atleta promissor chegam ao fim quando se descobre que foi morto a tiro. A família inicia uma luta implacável em busca de justiça.

programme.title: Vila Ideal - Ep. 31

programme.title: Superbook T10 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Superbook ou Superlivro, é uma série anime produzida pela CBN nos Estados Unidos que narra os acontecimentos do Antigo e Novo Testamento da Biblia. programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted T4 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Gordon explora as deslumbrantes Florida Keys, onde os habitantes locais inspiradores o desafiam a abraçar o modo de vida da República da Concha. Atravessa mares cintilantes, recolhendo dicas ao longo do caminho, enquanto se aproxima de lagostas, caranguejos e peixes, antes de enfrentar o chef audacioso e produtor de rum Paul Menta para um último cozinhado.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted T4 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Gordon viaja até à Ilha Grande do Havai em busca de ingredientes locais que sejam ono, ou deliciosos. Atravessando encostas vulcânicas, florestas tropicais e o oceano, Gordon caça, pesca e recolhe ingredientes para descobrir os sabores autênticos e escondidos da ilha. Enfrentando o Chef Makani Carzino, conseguirá Gordon fazer o melhor uso dos tesouros culinários ono do Havai e conquistar os habitantes locais?.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted T4 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Gordon descobre o património e os sabores extremamente ricos da Jordânia – desde o norte verdejante até ao deserto de Wadi Rum, no sul. Faz café com um beduíno, pastoreia ovelhas em ruas movimentadas e recebe ensinamentos de várias mulheres jordanas, cada uma mais intensa e difícil de impressionar do que a anterior, antes de enfrentar a chefe local Maria Haddad numa batalha real para impressionar o Príncipe e a Princesa em Petra.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted T4 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Gordon e a sua filha Tilly vão até à Galiza para explorar as tradições culinárias deste magnífico canto de Espanha, em larga medida ignorado. Depois de Gordon ter sido atingido por ondas monstruosas enquanto procurava cracas nas rochas, pai e filha apanham mexilhões numa barcaça e aprendem a fazer um queijo premiado, antes de enfrentarem o chefe Pepe Vieira, com estrela Michelin, e o seu filho para um último cozinhado.

programme.title: A Ciência Da Estupidez T2 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Um programa que mistura ciência pura e dura com alguns dos vídeos amadores mais loucos, espectaculares e impressionantes de sempre está de volta para uma segunda temporada. Neste episódio, aprenderemos quantas maneiras há de se embaraçar, se lesionar e humilhar enquanto conduz sobre água, opera uma grua e faz truques aéreos enquanto esquia..

programme.title: A Ciência Da Estupidez T2 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Um programa que mistura ciência pura e dura com alguns dos vídeos amadores mais loucos, espectaculares e impressionantes de sempre está de volta para uma segunda temporada.
